_header.promotion: src/prometheus/web/ws_server.py::_computer_frame_kinds() promotes every kind in this tuple to a first-class frame type, so each arrives as {type: <kind>, timestamp, payload}, never wrapped in sentinel_signal.
_header.note: COPIED VERBATIM from the server's tuple, in the server's order. When the daemon adds a kind, copy the new tuple here FIRST: smoke:computer then fails until the client decodes it. Never edit this list to match the client.
_header.not_in_the_tuple: computer_task_stop_ack is ws_server.py's reply to a client's {type: computer_task_stop}. It is sent to the requesting socket only, is not a SignalBus kind, and is never persisted or backfilled, so it is not in COMPUTER_FRAME_KINDS. The client decodes it as well; smoke:computer pins it separately.
